reason: Promote to active, scoped to codex-cli MultiAgentV2 with non-OpenAI Responses (custom) providers. In this failure, spawn_agent reports success while the task payload, sent as encrypted_content, never reaches the child agent. Multiple independent reports exist: #33551, #34833, #36586 and #37237 on 0.145-0.148, and #45233 on 0.154.0. The feature request #46939 for plaintext delivery is open with no official fix. A 2026-10-05 web search found no evidence of a fix, and community write-ups still describe the failure and a v1 workaround. Caveat: the earlier reports are recorded from search snippets, not issue bodies.

evidence.summary: Open on 0.154.0; children get an empty envelope; parent sees success; wait_agent times out.
candidate/known-applicable (remedy status watch); multi_agent_version v1 or separate codex exec process workaround; prior reports #33551/#34833/#36586/#37237 (from snippets).
Web search: community write-up still describes custom-provider subagents receiving no task and restoring plain delivery as the workaround; no official fix found.

assessed_models: codex-cli 0.145-0.154.0 with custom Responses providers (e.g. DeepSeek)
model_assessment.assessment: Harness and protocol defect that does not depend on the model.

remedy_assessment.assessment: Workarounds are useful but community-sourced and unverified. Revalidate when OpenAI ships plaintext delivery or deprecates v1.

reopen_triggers: same silent-handoff failure reported in another harness
